assembly: Retrospective combination of two separately frozen 20-episode cohorts; all declared controller/case combinations retained irrespective of outcome.
observation: Oracle actor states; traffic signals frozen green.
forecast: Frozen inD-finetuned learned forecast adapter; separate from the analytical linear-forecast planar timing configuration.

definitions.support_margin: Signed ego-enclosing-circle/oriented-actor support proxy; not Euclidean box clearance.
definitions.proximity_exposure: Time integral of sum_i exp(-max(d_i,0)/0.8m), in seconds.
definitions.jerk: RMS from velocity after a fixed centered 0.25 s mean, retaining startup and stopping.
definitions.continuous_summaries: Median of eight episode values, including non-goal episodes.
definitions.runtime_p95: Median of episode-level p95, including learned forecast where used, cache/planning/QP/tracking; excludes world tick, observation acquisition, visualization and logging.

interpretation: Descriptive spacing/exposure and execution differences. Collision-free completion ties several references; higher measured jerk and runtime remain visible. Class-label intervention changes both field and predictor inputs.
